name: usb
description: Detect USB peripherals, install driver recipes, and flash images to USB drives.

tools.name: usb.list
tools.description: List connected USB devices with vendor/product IDs, names, and serials.

tools.name: usb.drives
tools.description: List block drives, showing removable/USB status, size, model, serial, and mounts.

tools.name: usb.recipes
tools.description: List driver install recipes and whether their device is currently connected.

all.description: Include recipes whose device is not connected.

tools.name: usb.install_driver
tools.description: Plan or run a driver install recipe for a connected USB device. Dry-run by default.

dry_run.description: Only return the plan. Default true.

force.description: Plan even if the device is not connected.

tools.name: usb.flash
tools.description: Write an image file to a whole USB drive. Dry-run by default; real writes need confirm=<device>.

device.description: Whole disk, e.g. /dev/sdb. Never a partition.

dry_run.description: Only return the plan. Default true.

confirm.description: Must equal device for a real write.

unmount.description: Unmount mounted partitions first. Default true.
